question: What feed flow rate, nozzle size and inlet air temperature were used in the spray drying?
expect: 800 mL per hour, 0.6 mm nozzle, inlet 200 °C (4 bar, 18 L/min atomizing air, 4 m/s hot air) (sec. 2.2)
rendered: The document states that the powdering process of the dye solution was carried out using a spray dryer. The extracted dye solution was first homogenized and then flowed into the spray dryer system using a feed pump with a flow rate of 800 mL per hour. The solution was atomized through an air-pressurized nozzle (0.6 mm size) with a fogging pressure of 4 bar and a fogging air flow rate of 18 L per minute. Hot air was introduced into the drying chamber at an inlet temperature of 200 °C and a flow velocity of 4 m s−1.
